title: ODDLPRICE and ODDLYIELD clamp both dates to 30 on US 30/360 period lengths but keep standard US 30/360 for accrued A
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, ODDLPRICE and ODDLYIELD walk forward from last_interest to maturity in coupon-period steps (requiring at most 64 quasi-periods). For day-count basis 0 (US 30/360), the quasi-period length NL and period interest fraction DCI use a symmetric rule that clamps both start and end day-31 or last-day-of-February dates to 30 (days360_us_both), whereas accrued days A use standard US 30/360 (us_30_360), and negative day counts clamp to 0.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (rows 376 and 377) and full-bank witness sets: 2,952/2,952 ODDLPRICE and 2,957/2,957 ODDLYIELD rows matched.
